notes.title: Screen Scrolling Bug Patch.
notes.content:
Thank you all for the immediate reports of this pesky bug. The team has been hard at work with an immediate fix and we got it!

Please let us know if any other problems arise in the discussions for Known bugs and issues: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1083190/discussions/0/1608274347719093623/

notes.title: Enabling Full Screen Mode and Game Properties Menu
notes.content:
To enable Full Screen mode:

You can toggle it by using ALT + Enter

Also, you can hit F1 to bring up a Game Properties menu which enables you to change various settings. Check the Launch in Full Screen Mode.

Happy creature catching! :)

- DANGEN Entertainment
